transcript: Mei: Decision from the review. No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases. Ordinary release slots move to Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

decisions.statement: The team will not perform production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases.
decisions.rationale: Following the Friday release incident review, deployment restrictions are implemented.
quotes: No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases.

decisions.statement: Ordinary release slots are moved to Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
decisions.rationale: Friday deployments are no longer allowed.
quotes: Ordinary release slots move to Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
